item.title: Defense, rebounding carry Tigers to methodical win at Auburn
item.description: By RON HIGGINS, Journal Sports AUBURN, Ala. – It wasn’t exactly a work of art but more of a paint-by-numbers victory. item.title: Caddo Parish issues parish-wide burn ban
item.description: A parish-wide burn ban is now in effect in Caddo Parish as of Saturday, Feb. 8, 2026, due to extremely dry conditions and a lack of significant rainfall in the long-range forecast.
